Title: Up to 90% of Asian Americans Can't Fully Digest Milk — Is That You?

Description:
If dairy leaves you bloated, gassy, or running to the bathroom, low lactase enzyme activity is usually the reason — undigested lactose reaches your colon and gets fermented by gut bacteria. The NIH estimates 30 to 50 million Americans deal with it, and rates run far higher in Asian American and Black American communities than in those of Northern European descent.

Three things help the most: choosing aged cheese or Greek yogurt over fresh milk, spreading dairy across meals instead of one big glass, and taking a lactase supplement with your first bite of dairy.

Unexplained weight loss or blood in your stool points to something beyond lactose intolerance — see a doctor.

Start with Greek yogurt or aged cheese, spread milk across meals instead of chugging a glass, and try a lactase supplement with your first bite.
